en: The postcard is a hand-colored vintage image depicting a central town square bordered by historical buildings. In the foreground, there is a statue (monument) of a man standing on a pedestal, enclosed by a wrought iron fence. There is a child near the monument, horse-drawn carriages, and old-style street lamps, giving the scene a very early 20th-century or late 19th-century European atmosphere. The visual style is consistent with classic German postcards from the era.
